div.head: II Cn 42
div.ab: Ðæt man gehadodne man [ne] bende ne beate. Gyf hwa gehadodne man bende oððan beate oððon swyðe bismærige, bete wið hine swa hit riht sy, ⁊ ðam bisceope weofodbote be ðæs hades mæðe, ⁊ ðam laforde oððe þam kynincge be fullan mundbryce, oððe geladige hine sylfne mid fulre lade.

A man in holy orders shall not be bound or beaten. If anyone binds or beats or deeply insults a man in holy orders, he shall make amends towards him in accordance with the law, and shall pay the fine due to the bishop for sacrilege, in accordance with the rank [of the injured man], and to his lord or to the king the full fine for breach of his mund, or he shall clear himself by the full process of exculpation.

Gyf hwa gehadodne man bende oððan beate oððon swyðe gebysmrige, bete wið hine, swa swa hit riht sy, ⁊ bisceope weofodbote be hades mæðe ⁊ hlaforde oððe cyningce be fullan mundbryce; oððe geladige hine mid fulre lade.
